title: Sum Multiples
description:
You are given a positive integer n.

Consider all integers in the range [1, n] (inclusive). Find the sum of all numbers that are divisible by 3, 5, or 7.

Task

Return the total sum of all integers in [1, n] that satisfy:

divisible by 3, or
divisible by 5, or
divisible by 7
input_format: The input contains a single integer.
